answer: Because the rationale is hashed into the horizon record and indexed in the pulse history, the dawn audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Filling 165 aliases therefore needs 165 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 3 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
